name: Fair and Robust AI-Generated Face Detection
description: Develop machine learning models to detect AI-generated faces while ensuring fairness and robustness across demographic groups.

cr:input.name: AI-Face Dataset
cr:input.description: A large-scale image dataset with demographic annotations. Contains 1,646,545 face images, including 1,245,660 AI-generated and 400,885 real images. Each image is associated with demographic attributes (skin tone, gender, age), generation method, and a binary label (real or fake). Images are preprocessed (cropped, resized, augmented). Example: Image with skin tone = 5, gender = 1 (Male), age = 2 (Adult), generation method = GAN, real vs. fake = 1 (fake).
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions include a binary label for real vs. fake classification and demographic attribute predictions (skin tone, gender, age). Example: real_vs_fake = 1 (fake), skin_tone = 5, gender = 1 (Male), age = 2 (Adult).

field.name: real_vs_fake
field.description: Binary label indicating whether the face is real (0) or AI-generated (1). Example: 1.

field.name: skin_tone
field.description: Skin tone annotated using the Monk Skin Tone Scale (1–10). Example: 5.

field.name: age
field.description: Age category: Child = 0, Youth = 1, Adult = 2, Middle-age Adult = 3, Senior = 4. Example: 2.

packages: [FILL IN THE BLANK: other required packages]

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC), Fairness Equal Opportunity (FEO)
cr:evaluation.notes: Metrics are stratified by demographic subgroups (e.g., skin tone, gender, age) and intersectional groups (e.g., Female-Light, Male-Dark). Results are averaged over 5 random samplings of the dataset. For fairness metrics like FEO, lower values are better.
